text:
WS::payload
Description
WS::payload <length>
Returns the content that the WS::collect command has collected thus
far, up to the number of bytes specified. If you do not specify a
size, the system returns the entire collected content.
WS::payload <offset> <length>
Returns the content that the WS::collect command has collected thus
far from the specified offset, up to the number of bytes specified.
WS::payload length
Returns the size of the content that has been collected thus far, in
bytes.
WS::payload replace <offset> <length> <string>
Replaces the amount of content that you specified with the argument,
starting at with , adjusting the frame length in frame header
appropriately. The length argument should be the length of original
content to replace. In order to replace the entire payload, the offset
should be 0 and the length should be the original size in bytes of the
payload.
